description: This file contains the PHP class implementation for the 'Download' model within the 'Account' namespace of the Opencart catalog module. It provides methods to retrieve download details, list downloads, count total downloads, and add download reports.
published:
Opencart rom	he

classes.name: Download
classes.description: Model class handling download related database operations for customer account downloads

methods.name: getDownload
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific download by its ID, considering the order status and customer ID

methods.name: getDownloads
methods.description: Returns a list of downloads with pagination, filtered by customer ID and store/language context

methods.name: getTotalDownloads
methods.description: Counts total number of downloads available to the customer

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Adds a download report entry with IP, country, and timestamp for tracking purposes
